thread:
alex-finance: FYI found an unexplained ledger gap for ~14 customers this week (token undercount). Rolling numbers show ~7-20% variance on a few invoices. Need containment + owner for billing corrections.

sam-platform: I'll pick this up for platform. Can you attach the CSV of affected invoices?

alex-finance: Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/files/ledger-gap-1765.csv. Top 5 by $ impact are in the file.

jamie-sre: Triage: ingestion processor showed bursts of `RetryLoop` around 03:40 UTC leading to partial batch commits. We've throttled the worker group as a stop-gap.

maria-billing: Ownership ask: Sam = platform fix + reingest; Lee = instrumentation/alerting; Alex = invoice policy; Nora = CS comms/credits. Agree?

lee-eng: I'll add an alert for "partial-commit-rate" and a dashboard panel for ledger diffs. ETA 48h.

nora-ops: Drafting CS messages for credits vs reissue. Quick proposal: auto-credit if $ < $40 OR < 8% delta; otherwise reissue. Will pair with Alex.

sam-platform: Plan: patch ingest runner to make commit atomic and add stronger idempotence keys. Quick dry-run command for reingest preview: ```bash
python infra/tools/ledger_diff.py --since 2024-06-10 --preview
```

ops-bot: ops-bot: scheduled `ledger-preview` job by @sam-platform at 1765003000 (dry-run).

jamie-sre: After preview completes, we'll do a 50-account dry reingest then validate ledger parity. If green, full reingest scheduled off-peak.

alex-finance: I'll prepare prioritized reissue list after Jamie posts preview diff. Please include a note on how far back reissues can go without legal.

maria-billing: Setting follow-up cadence: triage updates here every 8h until reingest completes, then weekly until all invoices reconciled. I'll own the tracker sheet.

sam-platform: Patch PR created: https://git.redwood/pr/4955 (atomic commit + idempotence fix). Requesting reviews @lee-eng @jamie-sre. Canary in ~4h.

lee-eng: Reviewing now. Adding unit test for commit atomicity.

jamie-sre: Preview finished at 1765004200: ledger-preview shows 14 accounts with gaps, top delta uploaded to incident doc. Kicking off 50-account dry reingest at 1765004600.

nora-ops: Noted. I'll queue templated credits for sub-$40 cases so CS can action quickly.

alex-finance: Thanks team. We'll track closure when ledger-delta-metric stays <=1% for two consecutive weeks.
